mobileMoney._note: Root codes and the MTN send sequence were owner-confirmed on 2026-09-21; verify with a 10-pesewa run after any change. A network without sendSequence is never driven automatically (M-03).
mobileMoney._prefixes_note: Ghana mobile prefixes per network (NCA numbering, 2026; research: african_voice_and_protocols.md). A money read-back names the network ('an MTN number') and says so when a number's prefix is unknown or on another network than the SIM. Keys match networks below.

banks._note: Money safety round 2 (2026-09-29): VERIFIED bank USSD codes only (docs/agent/research/secure_payment_auth.md, 'Bank transfers'). A bank is added here only once its code is verified; GCB, Ecobank, Fidelity, CalBank, Access, ADB and AT Money were not, so they are named as unsupported and never dialled. Tekyerema only OPENS the code and reads each screen; the user chooses every option, confirms the payment and enters the PIN (guided, never automated).
